scope.intended_population: Veterans, surviving spouses, caregivers, and people of any age with disabilities; each program has its own scope.

organizations.name: National Alliance for Care at Home

programs.name: VA health care enrollment
programs.description: Ask VA enrollment staff about applying for health care.
programs.eligibility_summary: Service and VA enrollment requirements apply; age alone does not establish eligibility.
programs.application_or_referral_route: VA Form 10-10EZ: online, by phone, by mail, at a VA facility, or through an accredited representative.
programs.next_step: Ask VA enrollment staff about applying for health care.

programs.name: Veterans Pension
programs.description: Ask an accredited county officer whether pension should be explored.
programs.eligibility_summary: Wartime service, discharge, financial and age/disability rules require VA review.
programs.application_or_referral_route: VA Form 21P-527EZ; online or paper route on official form page.
programs.next_step: Ask an accredited county officer whether pension should be explored.

programs.name: Pension additions: Aid and Attendance or Housebound
programs.description: Ask the county office what assessment or facility certification is needed.
programs.eligibility_summary: Pension eligibility and additional care/housebound criteria apply; both additions cannot be paid together.
programs.application_or_referral_route: Official page names Forms 21-2680 and, for nursing home information, 21-0779; accredited officer and medical/facility professionals handle their respective work.
programs.next_step: Ask the county office what assessment or facility certification is needed.

programs.name: Survivors Pension
programs.description: Ask the county office about Survivors Pension.
programs.eligibility_summary: Surviving-spouse or dependent-child, service and financial requirements apply.
programs.application_or_referral_route: VA Form 21P-534EZ; online, mail, regional office or accredited representative.
programs.next_step: Ask the county office about Survivors Pension.

programs.name: Dependency and Indemnity Compensation
programs.description: Ask the county office to identify the correct survivor-benefit route.
programs.eligibility_summary: Service-related death or other statutory DIC criteria differ from pension.
programs.application_or_referral_route: For a veteran death, surviving spouse/child route is VA Form 21P-534EZ; active-duty death and dependent-parent routes differ.
programs.next_step: Ask the county office to identify the correct survivor-benefit route.

programs.name: Increased VA disability compensation
programs.description: Ask the county office about review of a worsened service-connected condition.
programs.eligibility_summary: An already service-connected condition that has worsened is a reason to ask; VA evaluates evidence and rating.
programs.application_or_referral_route: VA Form 21-526EZ online or paper, with an accredited representative.
programs.next_step: Ask the county office about review of a worsened service-connected condition.

programs.name: VA Community Living Centers
programs.description: Ask a VA social worker about the extended-care assessment.
programs.eligibility_summary: VA enrollment, clinical need and other VA rules apply; care availability is a separate assessment.
programs.application_or_referral_route: VA care team or social worker; Form 10-10EC supports financial/copay assessment.
programs.next_step: Ask a VA social worker about the extended-care assessment.

programs.name: VA Community Nursing Home program
programs.description: Ask a VA social worker about authorized community nursing care.
programs.eligibility_summary: VA-contracted community care has VA clinical and authorization requirements. A facility listing establishes no VA contract.
programs.application_or_referral_route: VA care team/social worker determines route and possible placement; Form 10-10EC supports financial/copay assessment.
programs.next_step: Ask a VA social worker about authorized community nursing care.

programs.name: Ohio Veterans Homes: Sandusky and Georgetown
programs.description: Ask Ohio Veterans Homes admissions about the current application and care assessment.
programs.eligibility_summary: Ohio residency, service/discharge, disability and clinical admission rules are reviewed by the homes.
programs.eligibility_decision_owner: Ohio Veterans Homes admissions / Ohio Department of Veterans Services
programs.application_or_referral_route: Use the Ohio Veterans Homes admission application and admissions-team review.
programs.next_step: Ask Ohio Veterans Homes admissions about the current application and care assessment.

programs.name: VA pension during Medicaid-covered nursing home care
programs.description: Ask about the pension/Medicaid interaction before changing any benefit.
programs.eligibility_summary: Paragraph (i) applies to a veteran without spouse or child, a surviving spouse without child, and a surviving child.
programs.application_or_referral_route: County accredited officer plus Medicaid caseworker; VA applies pension reduction rules.
programs.next_step: Ask about the pension/Medicaid interaction before changing any benefit.

amounts.label: Paragraph (i) maximum pension, subject to its scope and timing
amounts.effective_period: Effective November 5, 1990; statutory subsection expiration currently printed as November 30, 2031. Recheck before use and for amendments.

programs.name: VA burial allowance and memorial routes
programs.description: Ask the county office or VA burial program about the correct application.
programs.eligibility_summary: VA separately reviews allowance and memorial eligibility; a benefit is not a promise to cover all costs.
programs.application_or_referral_route: Burial allowance: VA Form 21P-530EZ, online or accredited representative; memorial applications use the VA burial hub.
programs.next_step: Ask the county office or VA burial program about the correct application.

programs.name: Ohio county assistance for eligible indigent burials
programs.description: Contact the county office about burial-assistance review.
programs.eligibility_summary: County commission investigates need and applicable statutory veteran/family requirements.
programs.application_or_referral_route: Ask the County Veterans Service Commission about ORC 5901.25 and 5901.27 before arrangements.
programs.next_step: Contact the county office about burial-assistance review.

programs.name: VA Program of General Caregiver Support Services
programs.description: Ask the VA Caregiver Support Team about general caregiver support.
programs.eligibility_summary: Caregiver of a VA-enrolled veteran needing personal-care support; local team reviews the route.
programs.application_or_referral_route: Local VA Caregiver Support Team / health care team intake.
programs.next_step: Ask the VA Caregiver Support Team about general caregiver support.

programs.name: VA Program of Comprehensive Assistance for Family Caregivers
programs.description: Ask the VA Caregiver Support Team whether PCAFC assessment is appropriate.
programs.eligibility_summary: Separate veteran, clinical and caregiver requirements; home care and duration criteria matter. Facility residence or family relationship alone establishes no stipend.
programs.application_or_referral_route: Joint veteran/caregiver application on VA Form 10-10CG and VA evaluation.
programs.next_step: Ask the VA Caregiver Support Team whether PCAFC assessment is appropriate.

programs.name: VA hospice care
programs.description: Ask the VA care team about hospice and coordination with community care.
programs.eligibility_summary: Clinical need and VA care requirements are assessed by the care team.
programs.application_or_referral_route: VA clinician / social worker evaluates and coordinates care.
programs.next_step: Ask the VA care team about hospice and coordination with community care.

programs.name: VA palliative care
programs.description: Ask the VA care team about palliative care.
programs.eligibility_summary: Serious-illness symptom and goal-of-care needs require clinical assessment.
programs.application_or_referral_route: VA clinician / social worker evaluates the palliative-care route.
programs.next_step: Ask the VA care team about palliative care.

programs.name: We Honor Veterans public resources
programs.description: Use public veteran-care resources and ask the clinical team about coordinated care.
programs.eligibility_summary: Recognition/training program; current page states Alliance membership required for participation as of March 2026. Public educational resources remain linked.
programs.eligibility_decision_owner: National Alliance for Care at Home for recognition participation; VA/clinical team for care
programs.application_or_referral_route: Official We Honor Veterans resource pages; care authorization remains with VA/clinical providers.
programs.next_step: Use public veteran-care resources and ask the clinical team about coordinated care.
